tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ta)༄༅/ /kha 'bar ma'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa don lnga pa bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang ni rkang gnyis gtso/ /tha dad med la phyag 'tshal nas/ /phyir zlog gzungs
(ta)༄༅/ /kha 'bar ma'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa don lnga pa bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang ni rkang gnyis gtso/ /tha dad med la phyag 'tshal nas/ /phyir zlog gzungs

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// kha 'bar ma'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa don lnga pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang ni rkang gnyis gtso// tha dad med la phyag 'tshal nas// phyir zlog gzungs las gsungs pa yi// nyams su blang ba'i rim pa dgod// de la 'dir phyir bzlog pa'i gzungs las gsungs pa'i don lngas rig par bya ste/ rgyun du mtheb kyus tshogs bsag pa dang*/ ngar glud btang zhing 'chi ba bslu ba dang*/ pha rol gyi byad kha bzlog pa dang*/ gri gug la brten te dgra bsad pa dang*/ chu zor la brten te mkhar bshig pa'o// de la dang por tshogs bsag pa ni/ rgyun du yi dam du byed pa ste/ de yang dus khyad par can la gtong na/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa bsham pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ gtor ma la gzugs mi dgos la bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i sgo nas chos skyong la bsngo ba'am/ yi dwags la bsngo ba'o// 'og ma bzhi po gang byed kyang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes dang gsum mo// dang po la lnga ste/ gnas khang ngam gtsug lag khang ngam/ yid du 'ong ba phyag dar byas la/ bla re dang lhab lhub la sogs pas brgyan/ sa gzhi la spos sna tshogs pas byugs la rdul med par bya'o// gnyis pa rten dgram pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rten dgram pa'o// gsum pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhung ba dang*/ dri lnga la sogs pas legs par byugs la/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa cig bya/ de'i phyi ru pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa cig bya'o// yang na de rnams kyi sar nas kyi tshom bu bkod do// bzhi pa sgrub pa po ni/ sgrub pa pos sha chang sgog btsong spangs la/ dkar gsum mngar gsum dang gos gtsang ma gon la spos chus lag pa byugs la/ kha shar du bltas la/ stan gsar pa nang tshangs can la 'dug ste/ maṇ+ḍal phyis la me tog bkram la/ rin po che'i khri gcig kyang gzugs so// lnga pa gtor ma bsham pa ni/ 'bru sna tshogs pa'i rjen phye la/ sman sna tshogs dang*/

mngar gsum la sogs pa blugs la chu dang 'o mas brdzis la/ de la gsum du bgos la/ gcig las lha bshos bya/ gcig las ngar mi khru gang pa/ snyim pa zed pa'am thal mo sbyar ba/ phrag pa g.yas la pho'i lo grangs bris pa dang gos dum dang bcas pa gzugs/ g.yon la mo shing gzugs la/ zangs la sogs pa'i nang du bcug la/ gong gi khri'u'i steng du bzhag go /gzhan yang glud chung brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ chang bu brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ 'bru sna tshogs pa'i chan dang bcas pa g.yas su bzhag bzang sman sna tshogs dang*/ me tog sna tshogs dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*/ chu gtsang ma rnams g.yon du bzhag gzhan yang chu gnyis sam bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa sil snyan gyis mtha' brten la bshams/ rol mo'i bye brag gzhan yang bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun yod pa las/ dang po lha bskyed pa ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su bsgoms la/ gong gi maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su tshom bu gcig bzhag cing ngag tu/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya na maḥ zhes brjod/ yid kyis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag can/ seng ge'i khri bsam/ de bzhin du g.yas phyogs nas 'dab ma drug la/ sngags 'di brjod/ 'dab ma drug la me tog tshom bu dgod de/ oṃ sarba bo dhi satwā maṇ+ḍal kā ya na maḥ zhes te/ de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ 'jam dpal ser po glegs bam dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ nam mkha'i snying po rin chen 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ sa'i snying po rin po che 'dzin pa/ sgrib sel dkar po bum pa 'dzin pa rnams su mos pa bya'o// de'i phyi rol 'dab ma brgyad la/ oṃ ma ho pas+tha na maṇ+ḍal la kā ya na maḥ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yas skor du tshom bu bkod la/ de yang rab 'byor dang*/

kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya dang*/ 'od srungs dang*/ shā ri'i bu dang*/ maud gal gyi bu dang*/ ma 'gags pa dang*/ kun dga' bo dang*/ nye ba 'khor rnams su bsgom mo// de'i phyi rol du yang nyan thos chen po rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa rnams bcom ldan 'das la 'dun pas ldang zhing thal mo sbyar bar bsam/ mdor na mgron thabs kyi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sprin gtibs pa bzhin bskor bar bsam mo// gnyis pa ye shes pa spyan drangs ba ni/ bdag gi snying ga'i 'od kyis bkug par bsam zhing*/ bden pa'i tshig 'di dag brjod de/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal rnams// sems can kun ni bskyab pa dang*// bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs slad du// gnas 'dir myur du gshegs su gsol// tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung*// lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po// nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang*// byang phyogs na ni rnam thos sras// phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba bcu// mthu chen stobs dang ldan pa po// 'jig rten khams la dbang byed pa// mchod sbyin gnas 'dir myur du gshegs// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang dang*// rlung gi lha dang lus srul po// gshin rje dang ni srin po dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs dang*// lto 'phye che dang grul bum dang*// gza' dang rgyu skar mkha' rgyu dang*// gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rnams// bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' nyon la// mchod sbyin gnas 'dir myur du shog /bdag gis dga' ston cher bgyid kyi// zhi ba'i yid kyis 'khod par gyis// zhes brjod pas ye shes sems dpa' rnams byon nas mdun du bskyed pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos rnams so so la thim par bsam/

mgron thabs 'jig rten pa dang bcas pa rnams so so la zhugs pa'i mos pa bya'o// gsum pa de dag la yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsag pa ni/ a ga ru dang*/ du ruska la sogs pa'i spos sna tshogs bsregs la/ dung dang cha lang dang rnga bo che la sogs pa rol mo sna tshogs pa yang dkrol zhing*/ rang gi lus rdul snyed du dmigs la/ ba spu ldang ba'i gdung bas/ de rnams la phyag dang mchod pa dang*/ sdig bshags dang*/ skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems bskyed dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba mdo sngags gang rung gi rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya'o// de nas mdun du kha la me 'bar bas gtso byas pa'i bgegs stong phrag brgyad cu dmigs la/ rang yi dam lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas 'di brjod/ hūm̐ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// ma lus bgegs rnams skrag mdzad pa// dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ bar snang khams kyang 'gugs byed na// lus can rnams la smos ci dgos// sems med pa yang 'gugs byed na// sems dang ldan pa smos ci dgos// 'di la gnod byed dgug tu gsol// na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis/ che ge mo la gnod par byed pa'i gdon 'di la gtor ma ster ba yin pas/ skad cig yud tsam la 'dir 'dus shig oṃ badz+ra ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bkug nas mdun du bskyed la/ de la ngar glud dang*/ chang bu dang*/ ting lo dang*/ glud chen po dang bcas pa'i gtor ma zhig sbyin no// de nas snod cig tu chang bu dang*/ glud chung re dang*/ mtheb kyu re dang*/

chan dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum chu dang bcas pa blugs la/ sngags ni/ oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pa bdun la sogs pa brjod cing*/ phyag rgya mchog sbyin byas la mchod pa'i sprin gyis mgron rnams tshim par bsam/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/ gzungs kyi che ba ni/ gzungs 'di phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis te bcur brjod na/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da lta na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ro// bden pa'i stobs ni rang ngam gzhan la yang brjod du gzhug ste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rang bzhin gyis gnyis su med cing tha mi dad pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa dang*/ bsnyems pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba dang*/ bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad pham par byas te/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru dang gzings lta bu'i bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa'i chos ni thog ma dang*/ bar dang*/ tha mar dge zhing*/ nyon mongs la sogs pa rnam par 'joms par byed pa'i bden pa dang*/ gzhan yang gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ mthu stobs dang*/ byin rlabs dang*/ pha rol gyi dpung rab tu 'joms pa phyag na rdo rje'i bden pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la brtse ba dang ldan pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dang*/ ma rig pa'i ling tog thams cad sel ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ dngos por 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba thams cad gcod pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*/

'gro ba rnams kyi dbul ba mtha' dag sel ba sa'i snying po dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rab rib dang bral bar byed pa sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'i bden pa dang*/ 'dri zhing lan ldon pa la mkhas pa'i mchog rab 'byor dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i mchog kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa chog shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs dang*/ shes rab phul du phyin pa rnams kyi mchog shā ri'i bu dang*/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che ba rnams kyi mchog maud gal gyi bu dang*/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gags pa dang*/ mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye ba 'khor gyi bden pa dang*/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa la/ sa bdag la sogs pa khyed rnams kyis gnod pa ci yang ma byed cig gal te gnod par gyur na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' las 'das pas/ ngan song gsum du skye bar 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi mthu dang byin rlabs kyis/ bdag cag rnal 'byor pa ming 'di zhes bya ba dang*/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad rigs su gyur pa rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams zhi bar gyur cig gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa lha'i gdon dang*/ klu'i gdon dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon dang*/ rlung lha'i gdon dang*/ mi'am ci la sogs pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi bar gyur cig gzhan yang rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe ring ba la sogs pa dge ba'i phyogs rnams thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/

zhes pa la sogs pa 'dod pa'i don du gtor ma re re la lan re re brjod la/ brgya rtsa brgyad them pa dang*/ glud kyi kha phyir bstan la/ sgrub pa po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'di brjod/ hūm̐ nyon cig ma lus bgegs kyi tshogs// lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs dang*// 'byung po mkha' 'gro la sogs pas// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// gnod par byed pa gang yang rung*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bzung ba las ni thar bar mdzod// bcings pa las ni grol bar mdzod// rin dang glud du gtor ma khyer// bdag gis de ring khyod mchod kyis// song zhig bgegs chen 'gro bar gyis// phyin chad de ltar ma byed cig /khyod kyi stobs dang rtsal mthong nas// khyod kyis bgegs byed mi nus min// khyod ni lha yi sprul pa ste// sngon chad mchod sbyin ma thob pa// de ring bdag gis khyod mchod kyi// me tog phreng ba spos dang dri// mar me zhal zas 'di snoms la// bgegs kyi rgyal po 'gro bar gyis// sngon gyi lan chags yod na yang*// mchod sbyin 'di yis bral bar gyis// dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' 'das dang*// dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa yis// gnod par gyur na ma legs kyi// bgegs chen khyod ni da song zhig /rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog 'dzin pa'i// mgon po chen po'i byin rlabs kyis// blo ngan gang zhig 'da' byed na// rdo rje 'dzin pas myur du spong*// spangs pa'i sems can chen po de// ji srid 'khor ba'i spyod yul du// ngan song gsum du lhung nas kyang*// shin tu mi bzad cho nges 'debs// bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas bka'// dam tshig las 'das rdul bzhin brlag /de yi snying la rab tu 'joms// de bas bgegs chen khyod song la// dam tshig mchog la 'da' ma byed// legs par gsungs pa 'di thos nas// gal te 'gro bar mi byed na// thams cad 'bar bar gyur ba ni// mar dang yungs kar mer blugs bzhin// gnod sbyin chad pas bsdigs nas su// de dag bde ba mi rnyed de// de yi rtsib logs g.yas pa ru// 'bras chen nad kyang 'byung bar 'gyur// gnod sbyin nad kyis btab pa na// sha bkra'i nad kyis thebs par 'gyur// lcang lo can gyi pho brang du// nam yang 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro// lus ngan grags dang ldan pa yi// khyim yang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro// 'byung po mang po 'tshogs pa na// stan yang 'thob par mi 'gyur ro// gnod sbyin dag gi dkyil 'khor du// zas skom dang yang bral bar 'gyur// bden pa'i stobs ni thos nas su// 'byung po gang dag mi 'gro ba// rdo rje 'chang chen khros nas kyang*// spyi bo dag nas 'gems par byed// spu gri'i so ni rnon po yis// de yi lce ni gcod par byed// mtshon cha shin tu rnon po yis// de yi sna dang rna ba gcod// 'khor lo spu gri'i so 'dra bas// klad pa rab tu 'gems bar byed// lcags kyi tho ba 'bar ba yis// de yi snying la rab tu 'joms// khrag dang rnag ni dron mo dag

/kha nas rab tu skyugs par 'gyur// zhes brjod la/ gtor skyel gyi spyi bor mu ne gser gyis bris pa gdags/ gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs la phyir mi lta bar khyer ro// sgrub pa po'i nad la sogs pa'i glud khyer bar bsams la thun brab cing*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ta kṛ ta ha ya gṛ ba hu lu hu lu/ che ge mo'i gnod pa thams cad da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ku ru swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ na mo badz+ra kro dha daṃ ṣ+ṭot+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha hastā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nān/ bi nā ya kā na/ mahā ga ṇa pa ti dzī bī tān+ta ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces drag tu brjod la bskrad do// gtor ma lam po che'i bzhi mdor kha phar bstan la bzhag pa'i steng sngon bgab/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma gnyis kyang blug go /dngos gzhi'o// rjes la rnal 'byor pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod bya ste/ mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol ba// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gnas// zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// gzhon nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron mas rab tu brgyan// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags// yon tan dam pa kun bsags pa// spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba// rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo// stobs po che la drag shul che// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba can// gdul dka' dag ni 'dul ba po// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes legs grub las gsungs pas bstod la/

bzod par gsol/ dge ba bsngo/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs par bya'o// gong du bgegs bskrad pa la sogs pa des gdon bgegs ma song na/ thab nag po gru gsum khru gang pa byas la/ tsher ma'i me sbar te/ de'i nang du dpal rta mgrin bskyed la/ de'i zhal du bsreg pa ni kham phor du yungs kar la bgegs shes pa dang mi shes pa bskyed la/ khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rang rgyud la bkug la/ mtheb mdzub kyis yungs kar bzung la/ oṃ pad+ma ta kṛ ta ha ya gṛ ba che ge mo la gnod par byed pa'i gdon che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rta mgrin zhal du sib sib bsreg par bya'o// de yang gsum las brgya rtsa brgyad du dbul bar bya'o// des nges par tshar gcod par 'gyur ro// srog glud la brten te 'chi ba bslu ba'o// pha rol gyi byad kha zlog par 'dod na/ gnas dang rten dgram pa la sogs gong dang 'dra/ khyad par mdun du gtor stegs kyi dbus su gru gsum nag po rtse mo dgra'i phyogs su bstan pa bri/ steng du zangs cig bzhag dgra phyogs su bstan pa'i rtse mor ngar mi khru gang ba cig bzhag de'i snying gar gru gsum brus la dgra de'i ming rus dang srung ma bris la gzhug rang ngam gang bsrung ba'i dpral bar mu ne'am oṃ āḥhūm̐ mtshal gyis bris la gdags/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bris la gdags/ 'bru sna tshogs dang me tog sna tshogs dang*/ mngar gsum rnams zan la bsres pa'i nang du liṅga bcug pa g.yas su bzhag dkar gsum chu dang bcas pa dang*/ bum rdzas rnams blugs pa'i bum pa g.yon du bzhag sgrub pa'i grogs la bum pa la yi dam gyi snying po bzlas su gzhug de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa/ spyan drang ba/ yan lag bdun pa rnams gong bzhin byas la/ rang lhar bsgom/ tshigs bcad dang bcas pas dgra bgegs bkug la/ ngar chen dang chang bu brgya rtsa brgyad la bstim/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba sngags dang bcas pas gtor ma bsngo/

re re la'ang bden pa'i stobs brjod pa dang bcas pa byas la/ phyed rdzogs pa dang*/ gzugs kyi kha dgra phyogs su bstan/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa thams cad tshar nas byad stems la sogs pa bskrad/ de nas gtor skyel bza' bcas tshim par byas la/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal gyis bskyal/ skyel khar bum pa'i chus gtor ma dang gzugs la g.yon skor du sbreng la/ gtor ma khyer ba'i g.yas nas 'gro ba'i mis gtor ma dang mnyam du bum pa'i chu sbreng zhing 'gro/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi snying po bzla zhing phyir 'gro/ gtor ma dgra'i gnas sam yul mthong ba'am/ lam rgya gram mam/ gang bder mnan pa bya'o// de nas gos rdul rdeb pa dang*/ bro la sogs pa bya'o// pha rol gyi byad kha zlog pa'o// bzhi pa gri gug la brten te dgra bsad pa la yang gzhan thams cad mthun pa las/ khyad par du ngar glud khru gang pa'i dpral ba snying ga mgrin pa lte bar dgra'i liṅga bris la gzhug chang bu brgya rtsa brgyad la dgra'i liṅga brgya rtsa brgyad bris la gzhug de rnams la dgra'i rnam shes dgug gzhug yang yang byas la gzhug de nas liṅga che ba lcags kyi gri gug gis gtubs la sngags bzlas te/ oṃ che ge mo mā ra ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta oṃ che ge mo mā ra ya a ba lo ki te oṃ che ge mo saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ gzugs dang chang bu dgra'i sha khrag tu bsams la sngags de nyid la bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig res dbul/ de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa la sogs pa gong ltar byas la/ gtor skyel sngar bzhin bsrungs la gtor ma sa gtsang sar bskyal lo// gri gug la brten te dgra bsad pa'o// lnga pa chu zor la brten te mkhar bshig par 'dod na/ lcags ma yin pa'i rin po che'i snod zhabs stegs can du/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ bra'o rnams bsres te/ chu'i nang du blugs la/ der rin po che bdar la/ chu la sngags len bdun bdun bzlas la/ mkhar la brdeg go
